Quantum 1.41.0 was certified on 2026-10-12. It pins **nucleus v1.32.0**, **quark v1.17.0** and **orbit v1.19.3**, with 28 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.40.0: nucleus goes from v1.31.0 to v1.32.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.16.0 to v1.17.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.19.1 to v1.19.3 (patch). 28 sibling modules change version.
